thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 02/01/2019: CYOU, CLS, KLIC, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, IBM, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 02/01/2019: CYOU, CLS, KLIC, MSFT, AAPL, CSCO, IBM, GOOG
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: +0.13%
AAPL: +0.47%
IBM: +0.24%
CSCO: +0.49%
GOOG: -0.73%
Technology stocks were climbing in pre-bell trading Friday.
Early movers include:
(=) Celestica ( CLS ) was flat following the release of the company's financial results for Q4, with lower-than-expected earnings and revenue that matched analysts' estimates; it also provided mixed guidance for Q1.
(-) Changyou.com ( CYOU ) was trading more than 9% lower after i t report ed Q4 adjusted earnings of $0.21 per ADS compared with $0.64 per ADS in the comparable period last year. Analysts polled by Capital IQ were expecting adjusted earnings of $0.51 per ADS.
(-) Kulicke and Soffa Industries ( KLIC ) was lower by more than 9% as its adjusted EPS fell sharply to $0.25 in Q1 from $0.55 a year earlier, but still better than analysts' estimates of $0.19 in a Capital IQ poll.
